prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Choose path redesign is the only kind of change shown to be helpful, winning 1 test.
Finish new screen changes showed no effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no effect across 2 tests, with 1 test stopped early due to worse adoption.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, choose path redesign, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Negative predictions were too low, as all tests with negative predictions measured positive or near-zero results.
Positive predictions were generally too high, though round 11 was underpredicted.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -2.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +11.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 87.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen informing returning users that signing in syncs existing pets so they do not reset account data. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account reset after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout: Update the pet selection screen layout to a grid featuring clear visual mascot choice cards. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high mean duration of 1017s, showing users need clearer choices.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Generation Tips: Add a tip carousel component and progress estimate on the waiting screen while the pet renders on desktop. (why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s, and support reported pets not appearing on desktop.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Start Screen: Add a new summary screen right after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop controls before concluding onboarding. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with pets after onboarding, and finish completion is only 64.8%.)
4: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Scroll Path Overview Flow: Redesign the story intro screen into a story_scroll layout with animated story cards introducing the pet journey. (why: Choose path screen redesigns were the only winning changes in past tests; engaging initial visual flow reduces initial bounce.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Loading Timeout Notification: Enable desktop notification options and connection troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen. (why: Support received 2 emails reporting that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to appear, leading to a 72.9% sign_in conversion.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Sample Quality Hint: Add a standard lighting and formatting hint to the upload_photos screen. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Mascot Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a spotlight stage layout featuring an animated mascot preview. (why: Finish stage drop-off is 35.2% with a mean duration of 5815s; spotlighting the completed mascot builds motivation to complete.)
8: [home, incentive] Waiting Screen Background Progress Notification: Add a desktop background completion notification switch and visible progress bar on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, causing users to minimize the app and forget to complete onboarding.)
